IntroducedBillHeader.Sponsors: Senate Committee on Higher Education (originally sponsored by Senators Carlson, Horn and Schmidt)

Bill.BriefDescription: Changing membership on the higher education coordinating board.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to membership on the higher education coordinatingboard; amending RCW 28B.80.400; and reenacting and amending RCW28B.80.390.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecAmd.BegSecText: RCW 28B.80.390 and 2002 c 348 s 1 and 2002 c 129 s 1 areeach reenacted and amended to read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: After June 30, 2004, the board shall consist of ((ten)) twelvemembers((, one of whom shall be a student, who are)) as follows: Fiveshall be representative of the public, including women and the racialminority community; one shall be a student; one shall be thesuperintendent of public instruction; one shall represent the twoyearsystem of the state board for community and technical colleges and beappointed by the state board for community and technical colleges; oneshall be appointed by the president of the University of Washington andthe president of Washington State University to represent the researchuniversities; one shall be appointed through a process developed by thecouncil of presidents to represent the regional universities and TheEvergreen State College; one shall be a faculty member in the fouryearinstitutions appointed by the council of faculty representatives; and p. 1 SSB 6129one shall be a faculty member in the community and technical collegesystem appointed by the state board for community and technicalcolleges. ((All)) The public representative and student members shallbe appointed at large by the governor and approved by the senate. Following the term of the chair serving on ((June 13, 2002)) theeffective date of this act, the board shall select from its totalmembership a chair and a vicechair who shall each serve a oneyearterm as chair or vicechair. The chair and vicechair may serve morethan one term if selected to do so by the total membership.

BegSecAmd.BegSecText: RCW 28B.80.400 and 2002 c 129 s 2 are each amended to readas follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The members of the board, except ((the chair and)) the studentmember, who are appointed by the governor shall serve for terms of fouryears, the terms expiring on June 30th of the fourth year of the term((except that in the case of initial members, two shall be appointed totwoyear terms, three shall be appointed to threeyear terms, and threeshall be appointed to fouryear terms)). The rest of the members serveterms as follows: (1) The student member shall hold his or her officefor a term of one year from the first day of July; (2) thesuperintendent of public instruction's term shall be concurrent withhis or her term of office; and (3) the member appointed by the stateboard for community and technical colleges, the member representing theresearch universities, the member representing the regionaluniversities and The Evergreen State College, and both faculty membersshall serve terms of two years.
